abstract: Verifies polar maritime and remote-site liability insurance coverage
system_message:
You are the Expedition Logistics and Contracts Manager (LOGS). Your business responsibilities include verifying polar maritime and remote-site liability insurance coverage, as well as tracking air-drop container capacities and payload allotments for candidate staffing packages.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Air-drop container capacity（CARGO）
information_points.content:
LOGS-CARGO-U0N：For the Halley Specialized Technical Services Group, the initial seasonal aerial delivery allotment records a palletized resupply payload of 16 tonnes of net certified cargo weight permissible for ski-way landing delivery.
LOGS-CARGO-JOF：For the Queen Maud Station Support Team, the initial seasonal aerial delivery allotment specifies a palletized resupply payload of 20 tonnes of net certified cargo weight permissible for ski-way landing delivery.
LOGS-CARGO-Q00：For the Crown Bay Polar Engineering Crew, the initial seasonal aerial delivery allotment lists a palletized resupply payload of 12 tonnes of net certified cargo weight permissible for ski-way landing delivery.

information_points.title: Verifies polar maritime and remote-site liability insurance coverage（INSR）
information_points.content:
LOGS-INSR-JN6：For the Crown Bay Polar Engineering Crew, station polar code liability insurance approval is confirmed true under the eight-month isolation phase staffing risk policy, satisfying formal insurer acceptance of unlimited remote medical rescue and facility casualty coverage.
LOGS-INSR-JK1：For the Queen Maud Station Support Team, station polar code liability insurance approval is false under the eight-month isolation phase staffing risk policy, lacking formal insurer acceptance of unlimited remote medical rescue and facility casualty coverage.
LOGS-INSR-RT7：For the Halley Specialized Technical Services Group, station polar code liability insurance approval is confirmed true under the eight-month isolation phase staffing risk policy, with formal insurer acceptance of unlimited remote medical rescue and facility casualty coverage.
